description: This PHP file defines the class 'ViewModifyProperties', which extends SugarView. The class handles displaying a user interface for modifying connector properties in the SuiteCRM backend, including generating navigation breadcrumbs and rendering a template with connectors data.

classes.name: ViewModifyProperties
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages the display of the 'Modify Properties' page within the SuiteCRM administration panel, specifically for connector configurations.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates breadcrumb navigation links for the module title, linking to the Administration and Connectors main pages, and adding the current title.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the current module tab, which is 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that prepares connector data, filters them based on whether they are enabled and have required fields, and then renders the modify properties template.
